scope.market_definition: The global physiotherapy services market encompasses a range of therapeutic services aimed at improving physical function and mobility for patients recovering from injuries, surgeries, or managing chronic conditions. Participants include physiotherapy clinics, hospitals, rehabilitation centers, and home health care providers across various regions worldwide.
